ja: 昨日の米国株、ダウは0.11%安なのに半導体指数は2.94%安ってすごい差…😳 中東の話で原油が5%も上がって金利も上昇、半導体だけドカンと売られたみたい。指数って中身が違うと全然別モノなんだね。今夜はCPI前で様子見だとか。 #米国株
en: wild how the Dow only slipped 0.11% yesterday while the semiconductor index dropped 2.94% 😳 oil jumped ~5% on Middle East headlines, yields rose, and chip stocks took the hit. turns out "US stocks fell" means very different things depending on which index you look at! #investing
